name: usjet
title: F-22 3d WG.jpg
author: Tech. Sgt. William A Keele
notes: USAF F-22A Raptor of the 3rd Wing, Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska (tail 'AK 3 WG'), the JBER fighter that flies NORAD intercepts of Russian bombers off Alaska; in a formation of all Alaska-based fighters, 21 Apr 2020 (U.S. Air National Guard photo 200421-Z-DV655-9279, https://media.defense.gov/2021/Oct/04/2002867051/-1/-1/0/200421-Z-DV655-9279.JPG; Commons tag PD US military). Left 3/4 view, nose LEFT, whole jet incl. both fins and tailplanes, plain blue sky. Original 5949x4249 (kept as assets-src/tmp-air/orig/f22_3dwg.jpg) cropped to box 450,950,5949,2800 and downscaled to 3200x1077 (PIL Lanczos, JPEG q95) = photos/usjet.jpg. The tip of the far-side tailplane ends ~9 px inside the original frame edge, so in the crop it sits ~5 px from the right edge (complete, but the alpha there is soft). Canva remove-background kept BOTH Raptors (the second one, 'AK 525 FS', flies above-left and is partly cut by the crop); exported transparent lossless PNG 3200x1077 (pro), final = Canva alpha + photo RGB (scripts/alpha_cutout.py), then the second jet was removed by keeping only the alpha component under seed (1600,780) (assets-src/tmp-air/scripts/keep_component.py; two separate components, the near jet kept: bbox x94-3199 y135-963). Sticker 1368x424. Checked at 640 px wide over the grid at 1x and 2x: one jet, complete, no sky left, 'AK 3 WG' identical to the photo. F-16 alternative if wanted: the F-16C of the 354th FW in the 24 July 2024 intercept frames (DVIDS 8549617/8549618).
